name: Aluminum articles subject to 50% Section 232 duty (Proclamation 10895 as amended by Proclamation 11021)
notes: Rate applies to articles entirely or almost entirely made of aluminum (Chapter 76), on full customs value.
Proclamation 11021 (April 2, 2026, effective April 6, 2026) restructured S232 tariffs into tiers:
50% — articles entirely/almost entirely of aluminum (this file; Chapter 76 codes only)
25% — derivative aluminum articles substantially made of aluminum (see steel_aluminum_copper_derivatives_04_02_2026.json)
15% — fixed industrial machinery, grid equipment, and (per Proclamation 11032 effective June 8, 2026) agricultural and mobile industrial equipment
10% — articles using ≥85% US-smelted and cast aluminum by weight (threshold lowered from 95% by Proclamation 11032)
Codes from Chapters 63, 83, 84, 85, 87, 88, 90, 94, 95, 96 that appeared in the original file have been reclassified as 25% derivative aluminum articles per Proclamation 11021.
